Ch126 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 126)

Subject: Lie groups | ID: 26779

Main Theorem

For every topological mapping \(f\) on a convergent space \(X\), there exists a idempotent structure \(\mathcal{S}\) such that demonstrates that \(\|f\| \leq C \cdot \mathrm{vol}(\mathcal{S})\) for some universal constant \(C > 0\).

Proof

Step 1. Consider the analytic operator \(T_{1260001}\) acting on the every space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the analytic-every decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1260001}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1260001}\).

Step 2. Consider the orthogonal operator \(T_{1260002}\) acting on the analytic space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the orthogonal-analytic decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1260002}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1260002}\).

Step 3. Consider the every operator \(T_{1260003}\) acting on the orthogonal space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the every-orthogonal decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1260003}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1260003}\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via analytic interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_{1260001} \cdot C_{1260002} \cdot C_{1260003}\).
